name: Grant to Films - Films in Hindi and the Languages Listed in 8th Schedule of the Constitution of India
briefDescription: This scheme provides financial grants and performance-based incentives to film producers who shoot films in Hindi or in the languages listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution within Uttarakhand.
descriptionMd: This scheme aims to promote filmmaking within Uttarakhand by offering financial assistance and performance-based incentives. It specifically targets film producers who choose to shoot films in Hindi or any of the languages listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution. The initiative encourages cultural production and economic activity in the state through the film industry.
benefitsMd:
*   Financial grants for film production.
*   Performance-based incentives for film producers.
*   Support for films shot in Hindi within Uttarakhand.
*   Support for films shot in languages listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution within Uttarakhand.
eligibilityMd:
*   Applicant must be a film producer.
*   Films must be shot within the state of Uttarakhand.
*   Films must be in Hindi or a language listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
